description: Source code implementing hash type API and commands for Redis, including listpack and hash table encodings, with functions for get/set/delete, iteration, conversion, and random element retrieval.

methods.name: hashTypeTryConversion
methods.description: Checks if a listpack hash needs conversion to hash table based on object encoding and size.

methods.name: hashTypeGetFromListpack
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a listpack-encoded hash by field.

methods.name: hashTypeGetFromHashTable
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a hash table-encoded hash by field.

methods.name: hashTypeGetValue
methods.description: High-level function to get hash value by field, returning C_OK or C_ERR.

methods.name: hashTypeGetValueObject
methods.description: Returns the hash value as a Redis string object.

methods.name: hashTypeGetValueLength
methods.description: Returns length of the hash value for a given field.

methods.name: hashTypeExists
methods.description: Checks if a field exists in the hash.

methods.name: hashTypeSet
methods.description: Adds or updates a field in the hash, converting encoding if needed.

methods.name: hashTypeDelete
methods.description: Deletes a field from the hash.

methods.name: hashTypeLength
methods.description: Returns number of elements in the hash.

methods.name: hashTypeInitIterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for hash traversal.

methods.name: hashTypeReleaseIterator
methods.description: Releases hash iterator resources.

methods.name: hashTypeNext
methods.description: Advances the hash iterator to the next element.

methods.name: hashTypeCurrentObject
methods.description: Retrieves current key or value from iterator for listpack encoding.

methods.name: hashTypeCurrentObjectNewSds
methods.description: Returns current key or value as a new SDS string.

methods.name: hashTypeLookupWriteOrCreate
methods.description: Looks up or creates a hash object for writing.

methods.name: hashTypeConvertListpack
methods.description: Converts a listpack-encoded hash to hash table encoding.

methods.name: hashTypeConvert
methods.description: Converts hash encoding to specified type.

methods.name: hashTypeDup
methods.description: Duplicates a hash object, preserving encoding.

methods.name: hashSdsFromListpackEntry
methods.description: Creates SDS string from listpack entry.

methods.name: hashReplyFromListpackEntry
methods.description: Replies with listpack entry as bulk reply.

methods.name: hashTypeRandomElement
methods.description: Retrieves a random element from hash.

methods.name: hsetnxCommand
methods.description: Implements HSETNX command.

methods.name: hsetCommand
methods.description: Implements HSET/HMSET command.

methods.name: hincrbyCommand
methods.description: Implements HINCRBY command.

methods.name: hincrbyfloatCommand
methods.description: Implements HINCRBYFLOAT command.

methods.name: addHashFieldToReply
methods.description: Replies with hash field value.

methods.name: hmgetCommand
methods.description: Implements HMGET command.

methods.name: hdelCommand
methods.description: Implements HDEL command.

methods.name: hlenCommand

methods.name: hstrlenCommand
methods.description: Implements HSTRLEN command.

methods.name: addHashIteratorCursorToReply
methods.description: Replies with current hash iterator element.

methods.name: genericHgetallCommand
methods.description: Implements HGETALL and related commands.

methods.name: hkeysCommand
methods.description: Implements HKEYS command.

methods.name: hvalsCommand

methods.name: hgetallCommand
methods.description: Implements HGETALL command.

methods.name: hexistsCommand
methods.description: Implements HEXISTS command.

methods.name: hscanCommand
methods.description: Implements HSCAN command.

methods.description: Replies with random hash element(s) from listpack.
